grandparents_cupboard.reason: Oats, milk, butter, brown sugar, walnuts, cinnamon and Bramleys are all plain kitchen staples, with no factory-made products.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream UK supermarket at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only two pans and a wooden spoon, and the techniques are simple stewing and simmering.

works.reason: 160g oats to 900ml liquid gives four creamy 40g portions, and two Bramleys stewed with sugar and a splash of water will collapse nicely.

honest_times.reason: Peeling two apples, chopping walnuts, toasting and stirring porridge fits about 15 active minutes, with the apples stewing alongside.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, names match their ids, and nothing unlisted apart from water appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Warm apple porridge suits a cold late-January morning, and the stewed Bramleys are the point of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English that a neighbour would follow without trouble.

hearty_healthy.reason: Oats, milk, fruit and walnuts make a filling, wholesome breakfast with only modest added sugar.
